documentation: This file documents the lexicon for the Linguistic Category Model (LCM) used to compute LA_OBJECTIVE. This is based on the prompt instructions given to the AI model in `src/ai/flows/calculate-la-objective.ts`.

categories.name: State Verbs
categories.description: Verbs describing a lasting state rather than a specific action.

categories.name: Adjectives
categories.description: Words that describe the qualities or states of being of nouns.

categories.name: Disambiguating Adverbs
categories.description: Adverbs that clarify or specify the manner, place, or time of an action. They often answer 'how?', 'where?', or 'when?'.

categories.name: Intensifying Adverbs
categories.description: Adverbs that modify the intensity of adjectives, other adverbs, or verbs.
